script: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth. It moves about 3.8 centimeters farther away every year. That is about as fast as your fingernails grow. Scientists measure it by bouncing lasers off mirrors left by Apollo astronauts. Billions of years ago, the Moon looked much bigger in Earth's sky.
